# A view's query must resolve when it is created, and a view cannot read itself.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/views.md

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS errors_views; CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW errors_views.unresolved AS SELECT missing FROM UNNEST([1]) AS id
=> error:

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS errors_views; CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW errors_views.circular AS SELECT 1 AS id; CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW errors_views.circular AS SELECT id FROM errors_views.circular
=> error:

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS errors_views; CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW errors_views.dropped AS SELECT 1 AS id; DROP VIEW errors_views.dropped; SELECT * FROM errors_views.dropped
=> error:
